summary: 8-phase plan created. Sequencing: Phase 1 builds and proves a redeploy-free shadow validator harness against the recorded baseline (exit 1, 10 violations); Wave 2 runs the two mechanical items in parallel (Phase 2 converts all four .tier call sites to a derived_tier function and downgrades the restated Double-Loading check to a warning covering its 49 pre-existing matches; Phase 3 fixes the two broken agent names in core's contracts/adversarial-verification.md and adds a union-valued cslib mirror entry); Phase 4 declares an on_demand property in index.schema.json and marks the 3 all-empty entries, preserving Dead Entry Check signal against the Tier-4 tautology; Phases 5-6 give all 25 meta-only entries real hooks (G1-G7); Phase 7 trims "meta" from the remaining 61 core + 1 nvim entries; Phase 8 attests the bar. The unreachable 'zero budget violations' bar is explicitly re-scoped (option b) to: tier check passes via derivation, dead-entry check passes via on_demand, double-loading reported as warning, and exactly 8 pre-existing per-agent violations remain with general-implementation-agent at exactly 68,560 and planner-agent at exactly 31,848 tokens (the documented +1,470/+331 line increases from items 1). Raising CAPS was considered and rejected: it would permanently retire the budget check as an instrument.
